text:
Lena W: Quick sync  Launch social plan for 'Serving Signals: Real-world Inference' webinar. Need final X + LinkedIn posts, one hero GIF, two 20s clip edits, and routing rules by EOD Thu.
Omar J: timeline ok. propose primary X at 9:00 PT, LinkedIn at 12:00 PT, reminder posts T+24h and T+72h. Also want a short threaded follow-up on X with a 3-bullet TL;DR and speaker quote.
Priya N: added the schedule + asset checklist: https://docs.google.com/serve-signals (tab: social-assets). Clips: 20s highlight (tech), 20s highlight (business). GIF for X hero (loop).
Lena W: Routing: utm_campaign=serve_signals_launch. If company_size>200 OR job_title contains "Head|VP|CPO|CTO" -> tag: enterprise_lead, route to enterprise-sdr via webhook. Else tag: inbound_webinar -> sdr-rotation. Also set source_platform field.
Omar J: copy drafts below. X short (dev): "Serving Signals: how we dropped p99 latency with smart routing & KV caching. Wed 26  Register -> [link]"
Omar J: X thread opener: "Serving Signals: real tricks for inference in production. TL;DR: batching, cache-aware routing, gradual rollouts. Register: [link]"
Priya N: LinkedIn post: "Join Redwood for 'Serving Signals: Real-world Inference'  A hands-on discussion on latency SLOs, cost controls, and rollout strategies. Reserve your spot -> [link]"
Lena W: prefer the X thread opener for eng lists. add utm_content=variant_thread/opener and utm_medium=social. We should also include partner handle @ScaleBench in the thread reply for credibility.
martech-bot: Scheduler preview:
```
platform: x
publish_time: 2026-06-02T09:00:00-07:00
copy: "Serving Signals: how we dropped p99 latency with smart routing & KV caching. Wed 26 \\u00b7 Register -> [link]"
image: serve-signals-hero-v1.gif
utm: utm_source=x&utm_campaign=serve_signals_launch&utm_content=variant_dev
audience: webinar-seed-6k
canary: true
```
Priya N: We also want to test two thumbnails for the clip ads (close-up of model graph vs team photo). A/B on LinkedIn for 24h. Track CTR -> register.
Omar J: Canary plan: seedlist 6k dev-heavy at T-48h. KPI to go wide: CTR >= baseline*1.12 OR signups >= 2% of canary.
Lena W: Engagement follow-up: 1) immediate thank-you email + calendar invite, 2) 6h after webinar post thread with clip + key metric, 3) 24h follow-up email with clip + slide deck, 4) LinkedIn article republish summary with speaker quotes (for SEO).
SDR Ops: For high-intent criteria: company_size>=500 OR job_title includes "ML" and seniority contains "Director|VP|Head" -> tag priority_enterprise and send to #sdr-enterprise with lead CSV row. Otherwise rot via sdr-rotation. We'll include lead_reason in payload (utm, form_answers).
Priya N: Asset specs: GIF hero 1600x900 max 3MB, clip MP4 1080p h264 20s, LinkedIn image 1200x628. Provide two alt texts per image and transcript for each clip.
martech-bot: Canary scheduled: id=canary-8812, time=2026-05-31T09:00:00-07:00, audience=webinar-seed-6k.
Omar J: Add one more  we should run a tiny paid boost to the canary (1 day, $250) to sample broader dev audience. If canary lifts signups, scale budget on platform.
Lena W: good idea. set paid_test budget param = 250. Ops-bot will need billing approval.
Priya N: I'll upload final GIF + two clip variants to the assets tab by Wed 2pm PT and paste file names.
SDR Ops: CSV mapping preview: email,first,last,company,company_size,job_title,utm_source,utm_campaign,lead_tag,priority,lead_reason. Will place mapping in sheet.
Omar J: QA checklist before schedule: 1) final copy in sheet 2) assets uploaded & alt text 3) utm test hits LP and records utm params on submit 4) form field test (company_size, job_title).
Lena W: Also set auto-merge A/B on X for first 120mins (headline vs thread opener) by CTR on register link. If winner not clear, default to thread opener.
Priya N: I'll draft the X thread follow-up bullets and speaker quote and drop in the doc.
martech-bot: Scheduler canary created: sch-8812, audience=webinar-seed-6k.
Lena W: thanks team. once assets + canary run complete i'll post results and handoff full schedule to ops-bot for rollout. :rocket:
